function.name: find_hotel
function.description: Search for hotels based on specific criteria like price range and pet policy. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city where you want to book the hotel.

max_price_per_night.description: The maximum amount you are willing to pay per night. This is a float type value.

pet_friendly.description: Whether the hotel should allow pets. Defaults to false.

message.content:
**Pet‑friendly train stations in Miami** | Station | Operator(s) | Pet Policy Highlights | Contact / Resources | |---------|-------------|-----------------------|---------------------| | **Miami Intermodal Center (MEC)** | Amtrak, Brightline, Metrorail, Metrobus, Tri-Rail | • **Amtrak** – Pets are allowed on board if they are in a carrier that fits under the seat or in the luggage area. The station itself has no special “pet lounge,” but there are restrooms and a small waiting area where you can keep your pet in a carrier.
• **Brightline** – Pets are allowed in carriers up to 20 lb (9 kg). The station has a dedicated pet‑friendly waiting area with a small water station. | Amtrak: 1‑800‑872‑7245 (or visit [Amtrak.com](https://www.amtrak.com))
Brightline: 1‑888‑BRTLINE (1‑888‑278‑5446) | | **Miami Central Station (formerly Miami Union Station)** | Amtrak (historical) | This station is no longer used for passenger rail service; Amtrak now uses the MEC. | — | | **Brightline Miami Station (at the Intermodal Center)** | Brightline | Same as above – pets in carriers, small waiting area with water station. | Brightline: 1‑888‑BRTLINE | ### How to confirm pet policies 1. **Amtrak** – Call 1‑800‑872‑7245 or check the “Pet Policy” section on the Amtrak website. 2. **Brightline** – Call 1‑888‑278‑5446 or visit the Brightline “Travel Info” page. 3. **Miami Intermodal Center** – The center’s website lists amenities and pet‑friendly services. ### Tips for traveling with pets in Miami - **Carrier size**: Make sure your pet’s carrier meets the size limits (Amtrak: 18 in × 14 in × 12 in; Brightline: 20 lb total weight). - **Water & food**: Bring a collapsible bowl and some treats. The MEC has a small pet‑friendly waiting area with a water station. - **Restroom breaks**: The station has accessible restrooms; you can use them for quick breaks. - **Check for updates**: Policies can change, so it’s a good idea to call or email the operator a day before your trip. If you’re looking for a specific pet‑friendly train route (e.g., Amtrak’s Silver Service or Brightline’s Miami‑West Palm Beach line), let me know and I can give you more details on the schedule and pet accommodations.
